spec.description: Cost of the SUBAGENTS: every worker, reviewer, deviation check and scout session of a flow (each its own session, never including the orchestrator). The orchestrator has its own dashboard.
Cost of all subagent sessions of tickets pushed within the selected time range (separate sessions; the orchestrator is not included).
spec.title: Subagent spend

spec.expr: sum by (role) (label_replace(label_replace(sum by (ref, role, session) ((sum by (ref, agent, session) (pi_flow_tokens_total{ref=~"$ref", agent!="main", kind="cacheRead"}) * on (ref, session) group_left (role) pi_flow_run_role_info) or label_replace(sum by (ref, agent, session) (pi_flow_tokens_total{ref=~"$ref", agent!="main", kind="cacheRead"}) unless on (ref, session) pi_flow_run_role_info, "role", "$1", "agent", "^([^:]*).*")), "role", "review", "role", "^Review$"), "role", "deviation check", "role", "^Deviation check$")) / sum by (role) (label_replace(label_replace(sum by (ref, role, session) ((sum by (ref, agent, session) (pi_flow_tokens_total{ref=~"$ref", agent!="main", kind=~"input|cacheRead|cacheWrite"}) * on (ref, session) group_left (role) pi_flow_run_role_info) or label_replace(sum by (ref, agent, session) (pi_flow_tokens_total{ref=~"$ref", agent!="main", kind=~"input|cacheRead|cacheWrite"}) unless on (ref, session) pi_flow_run_role_info, "role", "$1", "agent", "^([^:]*).*")), "role", "review", "role", "^Review$"), "role", "deviation check", "role", "^Deviation check$"))

spec.description: cacheRead / (input + cacheRead + cacheWrite) of subagent sessions, per role. Reviewers re-read a lot of the same diff, so a low ratio here means avoidable input cost.
spec.title: Cache hit ratio per subagent role (higher = cheaper)

spec.expr: count(sum by (ref, session) (pi_flow_run_cost_usd{ref=~"$ref", agent!="main"}) and on (ref) (push_time_seconds{job="pi-flow"} >= (time() - $__range_s)))

spec.description: Number of subagent sessions (workers, reviewers, deviation checks, scouts) in the selected range.
spec.title: Subagent sessions

spec.expr: avg(sum by (ref, session) (pi_flow_run_cost_usd{ref=~"$ref", agent!="main"}) and on (ref) (push_time_seconds{job="pi-flow"} >= (time() - $__range_s)))

spec.description: Mean cost of one subagent session.
spec.title: Average per session

spec.expr: quantile(0.5, sum by (ref, session) (pi_flow_run_cost_usd{ref=~"$ref", agent!="main"}) and on (ref) (push_time_seconds{job="pi-flow"} >= (time() - $__range_s)))

spec.description: Median cost of one subagent session.
spec.title: Median per session

spec.expr: sum(sum by (ref) (pi_flow_run_cost_usd{ref=~"$ref", agent!="main"}) and on (ref) (push_time_seconds{job="pi-flow"} > (time() - 86400) and push_time_seconds{job="pi-flow"} <= time())) or vector(0)

spec.description: At each point: subagent cost of tickets pushed in the preceding 24 hours (push time = when the run ended).
spec.title: Subagent spend in the last 24h (rolling)

spec.expr: sum by (ref, role) (label_replace(label_replace(sum by (ref, role, session) ((sum by (ref, agent, session) (pi_flow_run_cost_usd{ref=~"$ref", agent!="main"}) * on (ref, session) group_left (role) pi_flow_run_role_info) or label_replace(sum by (ref, agent, session) (pi_flow_run_cost_usd{ref=~"$ref", agent!="main"}) unless on (ref, session) pi_flow_run_role_info, "role", "$1", "agent", "^([^:]*).*")), "role", "review", "role", "^Review$"), "role", "deviation check", "role", "^Deviation check$")) and on (ref) (push_time_seconds{job="pi-flow"} >= (time() - $__range_s))

spec.description: Where a ticket's subagent money went: review, deviation check, scouts, workers... Hover a segment for that role's cost.
spec.title: Subagent cost per ticket, stacked by role

spec.expr: max by (role) (label_replace(label_replace(sum by (ref, role, session) ((sum by (ref, agent, session) (pi_flow_run_cost_usd{ref=~"$ref", agent!="main"}) * on (ref, session) group_left (role) pi_flow_run_role_info) or label_replace(sum by (ref, agent, session) (pi_flow_run_cost_usd{ref=~"$ref", agent!="main"}) unless on (ref, session) pi_flow_run_role_info, "role", "$1", "agent", "^([^:]*).*")), "role", "review", "role", "^Review$"), "role", "deviation check", "role", "^Deviation check$"))

avg by (role) (label_replace(label_replace(sum by (ref, role, session) ((sum by (ref, agent, session) (pi_flow_run_cost_usd{ref=~"$ref", agent!="main"}) * on (ref, session) group_left (role) pi_flow_run_role_info) or label_replace(sum by (ref, agent, session) (pi_flow_run_cost_usd{ref=~"$ref", agent!="main"}) unless on (ref, session) pi_flow_run_role_info, "role", "$1", "agent", "^([^:]*).*")), "role", "review", "role", "^Review$"), "role", "deviation check", "role", "^Deviation check$"))

quantile by (role) (0.5, label_replace(label_replace(sum by (ref, role, session) ((sum by (ref, agent, session) (pi_flow_run_cost_usd{ref=~"$ref", agent!="main"}) * on (ref, session) group_left (role) pi_flow_run_role_info) or label_replace(sum by (ref, agent, session) (pi_flow_run_cost_usd{ref=~"$ref", agent!="main"}) unless on (ref, session) pi_flow_run_role_info, "role", "$1", "agent", "^([^:]*).*")), "role", "review", "role", "^Review$"), "role", "deviation check", "role", "^Deviation check$"))

spec.description: Per ROLE: the agent type (scout, worker, reviewer, ...) when known, else the name before the colon. A session is one subagent session. Highest = most expensive single session; average and median are over the same sessions. The orchestrator is on its own dashboard.
spec.title: Cost per subagent role: highest, average and median session

spec.expr: label_join(label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(topk(10, sum by (ref, agent, session, subtask) (pi_flow_run_cost_usd{ref=~"$ref", agent!="main"})), "role", "$1", "agent", "^([^:]*).*"), "role", "review", "role", "^Review$"), "role", "deviation check", "role", "^Deviation check$"), "subtask", "–", "subtask", "^$"), "key", "|", "ref", "session")

spec.description: The ten single subagent sessions with the highest cost. Role = agent name before the colon (or agent type). Subtask = plan task for 1:1 workers. Tokens = all kinds for that session.
spec.title: Most expensive subagent sessions (top 10)

spec.description: Subagents = all subagent sessions of the ticket (separate sessions). Orchestrator = the main session's own cost. Ticket total = orchestrator + subagents. "–" = not recorded.
spec.title: Tickets: subagent cost
